create_visual_shape_from_mesh: create a visual shape from a domino OBJ mesh file with custom color and orientation
create_collision_shape_box: create a box collision shape with specified half extents for domino physics
create_multibody_grid: create a grid of multi-body domino objects with shared visual and collision shapes
configure_bullet_client_gui: configure a PyBullet client in GUI mode with planar reflection and rendering options
run_domino_simulation: run a real-time domino physics simulation with gravity and a transparent ground plane
